title: 10 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 10-field degree-100 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-27 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 30693482502048793/200000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=22071273417164279903693414578170725200796681160 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(153951/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
